original_test_intent: Exercise the intended AMD GPU stress workload at a controlled 45C environmental condition and compare its complete measured behavior with an approved GPU-specific specification, preserving that the source conflicts on MLperf versus RVS GST.
original_method: First decide the authoritative workload; if GST, pin ROCm/RVS source/build and exact `gst_stress.conf`, prove `-d 3` target mapping and duration, define metric/unit/aggregation/threshold oracle, stabilize the relevant DUT sensor at 45C, capture baseline, run once under independent safety monitoring, compare every required metric and error delta, then stop/restore and verify health.
manual_activity: GPU performance and chamber owners resolve MLperf/GST identity, approve pinned artifacts/config/target/duration/numeric oracle and 45C operation, and own verdict.
required_inputs: Decision selecting MLperf, RVS GST or separate variants
Signed/pinned ROCm/RVS or MLperf artifacts and immutable configuration
Stable GPU UUID/BDF/device-selector mapping and target-complete load proof
Exact duration and AMD spec metric/unit/aggregation/threshold matrix
45C DUT sensor/tolerance/soak, telemetry, watchdog, abort and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not build or replace latest software in place on an uncontrolled SUT
Do not execute until workload identity, selector and oracle are approved
Isolate SUT and monitor per-GPU thermal/power/fan/driver/BMC health
Abort on limit, XID/reset, process/config or chamber anomaly
Preserve logs and return workload/chamber/software state without automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Await workload/oracle decision and validate immutable artifacts
Run only approved workload once and compare all defined metrics
Stop/restore and report evidence without verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve MLperf versus GST and variant relationship
Approve config, `-d 3`, duration and numeric specification
Disposition metric/error anomalies and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic MLperf/GST prose preserves neither workload identity nor the literal RVS command and lacks all acceptance metrics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No stress command is executable until identity is resolved. If GST is selected, run the pinned documented equivalent of `../bin/rvs -c conf/gst_stress.conf -d 3` only after target-map proof.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Literal RVS command, 45C label, fifteen-minute attendance and 180-minute machine window remain evidence; actual duration and selector await approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Freeze a reproducible software/config manifest and produce a per-GPU metric table joined to chamber/GPU telemetry and baseline-to-post error deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces latest-source builds and vague matching with immutable, target-bound, quantitative execution after an authoritative workload decision.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: RVS GST output cannot count as MLperf coverage, and an MLperf run cannot substitute for the literal GST procedure unless explicitly approved.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Without numeric thresholds, a successful process exit proves only tool completion and cannot support DUT PASS.

project_override_considerations: Performance owner must decide whether three environmental rows share one GST profile or are MLperf variants; no cases are merged or deleted here.
expected_evidence: Approved workload decision and relationship across 45C/10C/25C variants
Pinned software/build/config hashes and stable GPU/device map
45C DUT sensor/setpoint/tolerance/soak trace and pre-health baseline
Exact argv, full workload output, duration and per-GPU utilization

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items explicitly name MLperf while Test Set and literal command identify RVS GST; Criteria supplies no named metrics or thresholds, so workload and acceptance are not reliably defined.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row242 Wistron-AMD GPU-00235-V002: decide whether authoritative 45C coverage is MLperf, RVS GST, or separate variants; if GST, approve pinned ROCm/RVS build, exact `gst_stress.conf`, `-d 3` device mapping and duration, plus the complete AMD-spec metric/unit/aggregation/threshold matrix and 45C DUT sensor/tolerance/soak.

review_improvement: Preserves the identity conflict and prevents tool exit or an arbitrary GPU spec from being used as a fabricated stress verdict.
independent_technical_reasoning: MLperf is a benchmark family with workload-specific rules, whereas RVS GST is a vendor stress module; their outputs and acceptance semantics are not interchangeable. The source also asks to build from mutable upstream locations, which breaks reproducibility. At 45C, target identity and quantitative thermal/performance/error oracles are essential because a workload can exit successfully after throttling, partial device selection or driver recovery.
